title: The Message
style: roots reggae, conscious reggae, 140 BPM, one-drop groove, live drum kit, deep dub bass, guitar skanks, Hammond organ comping, horn section stabs, tape echo delay, spring reverb, analog saturation, warm live room, late 70s mix, call-and-response vocals, soulful male harmonies, revolutionary drive, spiritual uplift
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah… from the roots…
This is what reggae really means…
One love… one heart… one message…
[Verse 1]
They try to keep us down in Babylon
But we rise with the power of the drum
They build their walls, we plant our seeds
We don’t need their chains, we want to be free
From Trench Town to the world we sing
The same cry that the ancestors bring
No more fighting for the things we need
We just want to live, we just want to breathe
[Chorus]
This is reggae… this is the message
One love, one heart, one people, one destiny
This is reggae… this is the fire
We don’t fight with guns, we fight with melody
Get up, stand up… don’t give up the fight
Redemption songs are still alive tonight
This is reggae… this is the light
Coming from the roots and shining through the night
[Verse 2]
They sell us dreams but we dream for free
We don’t need their wars, we need unity
Faith is for healing, music is prayer
We don’t live in fear, we live in Jah’s care
They divide us by color, by class, by name
But when the bassline drops, we all feel the same
From Africa to Jamaica the message is clear
The truth is simple… but they live in fear
[Bridge]
Some say it’s just music, some say it’s just sound
But Bob Marley shouted it loud and proud
“Get up, stand up”, he taught us not to break
His redemption songs still live in every heart that aches
He gave voice to the voiceless, hope to the poor
Opened up prisons without opening doors
So when they ask you what reggae really means
Tell them it’s more than rhythm… it’s Bob Marley’s dream
[Chorus – Final]
This is reggae… this is the message
One love, one heart, one people, one destiny
This is reggae… this is the fire
We don’t fight with guns, we fight with melody
Get up, stand up… don’t give up the fight
Redemption songs are still alive tonight
This is reggae… this is the light
Coming from the roots… and it’s burning bright
[Outro]
One love…
One heart…
Just like Bob Marley showed us…
Let’s get together and feel alright…
Yeah… this is reggae.
